caption:
Only seven words can follow a comma joining two sentences.

For, and, nor, but, or, yet, so. "The museum was packed, still we stayed" is a comma splice; "yet" fixes it.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Only seven words can follow a comma joining two sentences: FANBOYS.

youtube.title: Comma + FANBOYS: The Only Way a Comma Joins Sentences
youtube.description: A comma can join two complete sentences only with for, and, nor, but, or, yet, or so. Anything else is a comma splice.
